description: Smart-money traders on a token — the 10 wallets that traded the most USD on it in the window (buys, sells, net, trades), each graded smart / profitable / mixed / losing from its own 30-day realized PnL and win rate (Base only for now), plus smart_lean: accumulating / distributing / mixed / none. 404/free if no trades in the window; 503/free if a data source is down. Costs $0.02 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.
